Depending on your search, Firefox can show information such as stock prices, sports scores, and flight status updates without requiring you to open a webpage.
{note}'''Note:''' Availability of stock, sports and flight suggestions may vary by region and Firefox version.{/note}
*'''United States''' starting in [[Find what version of Firefox you are using|Firefox version]] 143.

__TOC__

=View stock market suggestions=
You can access stock market information in real-time directly from the address bar with Firefox Suggest through specific keywords. Massive, an [https://wikipedia.org/wiki/API API] provider, powers these suggestions, and you’ll need to opt in to Firefox Suggest to get accurate information.

==If you’re based in the US==
#Open Firefox and type a keyword like '''stocks''' or '''stock GOOG''' in the address bar.
#Stock details will appear directly in the suggestion results.
#;[[Image:stock]]
#Now, type keywords like '''stock Microsoft''' or '''stock Nvidia''' to see real-time information.
#;[[Image:stocksuggestions]]
{note}'''Note:''' Keywords not listed above can trigger the stock market suggestions.{/note}

=View sports scores and schedules=
You can view sports scores, schedules and game information directly from the address bar. [https://sportsdata.io/ Sportsdata.io] powers these suggestions.
#Open Firefox.
#Type a sports-related search in the address bar.
#;[[Image:sportssuggestionsfirefox]]
'''Examples:'''
*knicks score
*yankees game
If information is available, Firefox displays a sports score or schedule suggestion in the address bar results panel.

=Check flight status=
You can check the status of a flight directly from the address bar. [https://www.flightaware.com/ FlightAware] powers these suggestions.
#Open Firefox.
#Enter a valid flight number in the address bar.
#;[[Image:flightssugestionsfirefox]]
'''Example:'''
*AC185
If flight information is available, Firefox displays a flight status suggestion in the address bar results panel.
{note}'''Tip:''' You can find a flight number on an airline's website or flight status page.{/note}
